name: Starting XI count is exactly eleven per team across a sample of matches
description: When the lineups artifacts for two different matches are fetched, each team's starting_xi holds exactly eleven players, ruling out off-by-one lineups of ten or twelve on any sampled fixture.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id and the second match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the first id
Read the lengths of home.starting_xi and away.starting_xi for the first match
Verify both home.starting_xi and away.starting_xi have a length of exactly eleven for the first match
Navigate to /match-lineups/<second-id>.json using the second id
Read the lengths of home.starting_xi and away.starting_xi for the second match
Verify both home.starting_xi and away.starting_xi have a length of exactly eleven for the second match
